book.name: Aposel
book.title: Aposel heki’walaŋ kwanai diniŋ kahat Lukdi youkuk

content: Pol adi metam nadisukiliti tigiŋ mede yeniŋkiliti titauyeŋ Gilik wosuwaguk
Kakali wapum u kulemaune Pol adi me nadisukiliti tagiŋ yenimbu buŋa bopneune mede yeniŋkiliti tiŋa yapmeeŋ Masedoniyade uguk.
Uŋandiŋ yauŋa metam kayoŋbop tigiŋ Mede Momooŋ yeniŋa yeniŋkiliti tiyauŋa wooŋ Gilik wosuwaguk.
Uŋoŋ muyakip lufomkulitniŋ hatiŋa Siliyade we tiulidoko tuguk, iŋgoŋ uŋoŋ Judame hekidi uutdok mede yohebet kabukabup tigiŋ nadiŋa kotigoŋ Masedoniyakade uguk.
Masedoniyakade uguk kaŋ me indiŋdi kelegiŋ, Beliyaniŋ Sopata adi Pilas mihiŋiŋ agaŋ Tesalonaikahi Alistaka dut Sekundo, agaŋ Debihi Gaiyus dut Timoti, agaŋ Esiya yokwet wapunehi Tikikus dut Tolofimo.
Me unduŋdi timeŋ wooŋ Tolowa uŋoŋ woomnimgiŋ.
Kaŋ indi belet haguwonit mokit diniŋ hinamuni nai dapmaluguk kaŋ Filipai uŋgoŋ muwage foloŋ looŋ ugumun. Helebufa kohofukuŋ dapmaune Tolowa uŋgoŋ wooŋ yabuŋa uŋoŋ Sonda kubugoŋ hatigumun.
Poldi Tolowa uŋoŋ Yutikas kumuŋ gineniŋ kotigoŋ tubukaikaguk
Sonda timiŋ Dumuŋ nane bopnegumun. Bopneeŋ Poldi heleune agaŋ uuŋdok nadiguk doktiŋa Mede Momooŋ yolu yolu timiŋ lekiŋgoŋ tuguk.
Yotmaaŋ foloniŋ indi hakumuneŋ uŋoŋ kamaŋ fee hinek ila dagiŋ.
Kaŋ mekuya niŋ wou Yutikas adi yot dobutom

foloniŋ ila Poldi mede yoguk u ila nadiguk. Yagigi hinek yoguk doktiŋa Yutikas adi ha nadigenadige damo deimbakap ila tuguk. Unduŋ ila tige deikauleeŋ mage mage kwetfoloŋ maguk. Kaŋ fooŋ tubupilali kagiŋ e, agaŋ kumuŋ tuguk. Yot u kweheyeniŋ hinek magiŋ ala adi yotmaaŋ foloniŋ 3 wondok hali maaŋ kwetfoloŋ foguk.
Kaŋ Poldi fooŋ Yutikas folooŋ foloŋ maaŋ hali metam indiŋ yeniŋguk, “Hidi nadibedi mu tineŋ, adi agaŋ kaikalak.”
Unduŋ yeniŋa kotigoŋ foloniŋ looŋ Dumuŋ nagiŋ. Naaŋ metam dut mede yoyo ha tulutulu mele labune biyabuŋa uguk.
Kaŋ metam adi mekuya u kaikaune welemomooŋ nadiŋa nagila ypmande ugiŋ.
Pol adi Tolowa bikabuŋa yauge yauge Mailitas wosuwaguk
Unduŋ tiŋa noli indi Poldi niniŋkulune muwage foloŋ looŋ Asode ugumun. Wooŋ Pol uŋgoŋ woomiyanene Pol ne kwet tabe wooŋ nibune
muwage foloŋ noŋgoŋ looŋ wooŋ Mitilini yokwetneŋ wosuwagumun.
Uŋaniŋ pilakumundi heleune Kiyo wosuwagumun. Uŋaniŋ wooŋ Samos wosuwagumun, uŋaniŋ heleŋ yauge yauge Mailitas yokwetneŋ wosuwagumun.
Kaŋ Pol adi Pentikos gulet foloŋ Jelusalem wosuwawe yoguk doktiŋa Efeso yokwetneŋ fooŋ Esiya maaneŋ yaune nai dapmawaakneŋ doktiŋa dapmatau hogok tiŋa wooŋ Mailitas yokwetneŋ wosuwagumun.
Poldi Efeso kayoŋbop diniŋ talitimeŋ mede yeniŋkiliti tiŋa yapmeeŋ uguk
Uŋoŋ wosuwaaŋ hali mede kameune Efeso kayoŋbop’walaŋ uune me kayoŋbop’walaŋ talitimeŋ hogohogok Pol kane ugiŋ.
Wosuwaune Poldi mede indiŋ yeniŋguk, “Hidi nu Esiya kwet wapum iŋoŋ timeŋ busuwaaŋ hidigut dediŋ hatigut u agaŋ nadiiŋ.

Buŋa Wapum’walaŋ kwanai-me doktiŋa kwanaine tibene Judame hekidi nunut tine mede yohebet kabukabup tagiŋ kaŋ fiit fafaŋe tiŋa dautilitilitne makwaneu kwanai tulugut. Tiŋa natok nadiwe foune fiit kwanaine hogok tulugut.
Tiŋa nu hidi yohineŋ be metam bop wapum gineŋ yawooŋ mede yolugutneŋ nemek hehitubu-lodadok nemu kamehebiŋa yolugut.
Me fekhinit mokit be Judame habuhaŋinda mu tiŋa kadakaniŋhik sigilulum timiŋa Bepaŋ’walaŋkade udaneeŋ Wapumnik Jesu nadisukilitimineŋ haniŋgut.
“Kaŋ i agaŋ Munabuli’walaŋ mede tagimneeŋ Jelusalemde wit, uŋoŋ nemek mintanambek mu nadilat.
Yokwet noli yaugutneŋ adigili Munabulidi yot fafaŋeniŋneŋ fofoŋdok be malabumuŋ niŋ mintanamdok u agaŋ naniluguk.
Bepaŋ’walaŋ welesiloŋŋiŋdok mede yohautadok kwanai u Wapum Jesudi namguk. Tiŋa talik yaudok naniŋguk uŋakoŋ keleeŋ yawe dapmawaak yoŋa na’walaŋ hatihatinedok nadiwe tuwaŋit mokit tilak.
“Hidi hogohogok itowiiŋneŋ agaŋ yaudapmaaŋ Bepaŋ’walaŋ Hatihati Uŋgoniŋdok yobe nadigiŋ, ala i wit i kotigoŋ hidi’walaaniŋ nebek niŋdi mu nabaak.
Unduŋ doktiŋa kulemaŋgoŋ indiŋ hanindakalewit. Nebek niŋdi filaak u nu’walaŋ yom moŋ, u hide’walaŋ nemek.
Nu Bepaŋ’walaŋ talii be Mede Momooŋ u agaŋ hanindapmaŋ tibe nadigiŋ.
“Unduŋ doktiŋa hide kikadoko tiŋa dompa Uŋgoniŋ Munabulidi hidi kohohik foloŋ yapmeguk u Bepaŋ ne mihiŋiŋdi yehituwaguk doktiŋa momooŋgoŋ yabudokoneeŋ.
Nu bihabuŋa wit kaŋ kamo moihidi
buŋa dompa yehisitubukadaka tineeŋ u agaŋ nadiŋa hanilat,
tiŋa undugoŋ hide’walaaniŋ niŋdi kayoŋbop yalaŋ yeniŋa yanagila talik fai yalineeŋ.
Undudegoŋneŋ doktiŋa gulet lufomkulitniŋ maaneŋ makat dautilitilitnit helebufa indigoŋ tuwot hanindidimegut u naditomuŋa kikadoko tiŋa hatineeŋ.
“Ala kamiŋ Bepaŋ kohoŋ foloŋ hapmelat, kaŋ welekulema medeŋiŋ haniŋgut wondi hehitubu-lodawek. Adi Saŋiniŋ Molomdi nadisukilitihik tububediŋa mehinekŋiyedok kahaŋ kame hatilak u hambek.
Nu nebek niŋ’walaŋ muneeŋdok be tinahukut fofohidok nadinadi mu tugut.
Hide-ku agaŋ nadiiŋ, nu na kohone yendi kwanailewe mintaune me nehikeleyaugiŋ be na indi tuwot moŋgokumun.

Tiŋa nu nemenemek hanindidimeeŋ kwanai fafaŋeŋ tiŋa metam fiyewakahi be gweheyehi u yehitubu-lodadok haniŋgut, ale Wapum Jesu ne mede indiŋ yoguk u kaule mu tineŋ, ‘Siloŋ toboniŋ tiyemtiyem’walaŋ nadifodi nemek toboniŋ datok hogok yabukahilekahile diniŋ nadifo u kalakapme hinek tilak.’”
Mede unduŋ yodapmaaŋ Pol adi me noli dut noŋgoŋ mulelem tiŋa Bepaŋ ninadigiŋ.
Bepaŋ ninadidapmaaŋ kotigoŋ mu kaneeŋ yeniŋguk wondoktiŋa kohoŋ kulimiŋa makat kisaŋ kokiŋ. Unduŋ tiŋa nagi wooŋ muwage foloŋ kamegiŋ.

footnotes.text: Yot dobutom wou noli Bagi Mede gineŋ “winduwa” yoyam.
Kamo moihi u hinale yalayalaŋ hekidok kamekaaŋ yoguk.
